# Documentation
URL: /docs

Components, runtimes, and primitives for building AI chat interfaces in React, React Native, and the terminal.

> For AI agents: a documentation index is available at [llms.txt](/llms.txt). Use `.md` for canonical markdown pages; `.mdx` is kept as a backwards-compatible alias on supported URL paths.

```
npx assistant-ui@latest create
```

Already have an app? See [adding assistant-ui to an existing project](/docs/installation).

## One library, any interface

- [Base](/demos/base) — The full assistant-ui experience, unthemed.
- [ChatGPT](/demos/chatgpt) — A ChatGPT look and feel, rebuilt on assistant-ui.
- [Claude](/demos/claude) — A Claude look and feel, rebuilt on assistant-ui.
- [Grok](/demos/grok) — A Grok look and feel, rebuilt on assistant-ui.
- [Gemini](/demos/gemini) — A Gemini look and feel, rebuilt on assistant-ui.
- [Perplexity](/demos/perplexity) — A Perplexity look and feel, rebuilt on assistant-ui.
